story.text: On a long autumn walk, Anne rests behind a {HEDGEROW} and overhears Wentworth praising Louisa’s {FIRMNESS}. He holds up a glossy {HAZELNUT} that has outlasted every storm: “Let those who would be happy be firm.” Then Anne hears that Charles once {PROPOSED} to her. Later, seeing her worn out, Wentworth quietly hands her into the Crofts’ {CARRIAGE}.
story.caption: “Here is a nut,” said he, “to exemplify”
